infobox.effect: Provides 64 inventory slots while only taking up 9

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- Cannot be stored in a backpack and Secure containers.
- Only obtainable as a reward from the "EXFIL Brothers" program.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Medicine case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 64 inventory slots in a 8x8 grid and only takes up 9 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Meds
- Medical supplies
